crew_members.name: Nine Lives
crew_members.description: A calico cat — burnt orange and white, one burn scar tracing her left cheekbone into her whiskers, amber eyes that are always slightly amused. Found drifting in a damaged escape pod. Has cheated death so many times the crew thinks she's immortal.
crew_members.recruitment_story: Nine Lives and Aristotle are old friends from the streets. When you find her drifting in a damaged escape pod near the Asteroid Belt, she grins through the static and says she's been waiting for a ride. She joins without hesitation — old debts and older loyalties.
crew_members.trait_description: Reduces crew casualty chance and boosts hull repair rate.

family.halix: Wife — died in the crystal drive explosion that gave Nine Lives her crystal-sense. Never replaced.
family.minnow: Adopted daughter, age 17, raised by Halix's sister on a quiet agricultural moon. Thinks Nine Lives is a distant aunt who sends presents.

crew_members.backstory_secret: Caught in a crystal drive explosion at age 26, Nine Lives survived with an ability she hides: she can hear the crystals as living things, the way fairies do. She recognised Aristotle as a listener the moment she met him — not consciously, but in the same way she recognises crystal-song. She has been protecting him without telling him why.

crew_members.name: No Tail
crew_members.description: Dark chocolate-brown shorthair, lean and economical. Missing tail and left ear — both lost in the same raid, worn like a record rather than hidden. Amber-gold eyes that assess every room once and then stop moving. Found defending a besieged outpost alone.
crew_members.recruitment_story: No Tail stands alone on the walls of a crumbling outpost, surrounded by League wreckage. She doesn't flinch when you approach — just sizes you up. 'Prove you're not soft,' she growls. Only strength earns her respect.
crew_members.trait_description: Increases weapon damage and grants bonus chance for critical hits.

family.rook: Brother — taken prisoner during a Canis League raid on a Corsair refuelling station when Quinn was 19. Has been in a League labour camp for 11 years. Quinn does not know he is alive. If Aristotle allies with Dave in Arc 3, Dave can access records and find Rook.
family.family_lost: Most of her family died in the same League raid that took her tail, left ear, and brother.

crew_members.backstory_secret: The name of the League officer who ordered the strafing run is written inside her jacket. The officer is still alive, serving as a quartermaster at a League supply depot. Her grudge is personal, specific, and unrelenting — not ideological.

crew_members.name: Silky
crew_members.description: Long-haired silver-blue cat, fur so pale it catches light like water. Pale blue eyes, the fairy inheritance showing through. Always stands slightly apart, like she's listening to a frequency no one else can hear. Found trapped in a fairy-realm labyrinth.
crew_members.recruitment_story: You find Silky in the shifting corridors of a fairy labyrinth, calmly sketching star charts on the walls. She already knows your name. 'I was wondering when you'd arrive,' she says, tucking the charts under one arm. She joins without being asked.
crew_members.trait_description: Unlocks hidden routes, reduces travel time, and increases exploration discovery rate.

family.thornquill: Father — a fairy named Thornquill, exiled by the Fairy Realms for his forbidden relationship with Silky's cat mother. Has wings the colour of river stones and a quiet voice. Never recovered from losing Vesper but is unfailingly kind to Silky.
family.vesper: Mother — a Court Cat named Vesper who died of a fairy-realm illness cat biology could not withstand. Disowned by the Feline Courts for her relationship with Thornquill.
family.moth: Half-sister on the fairy side — a young fairy bud who has never left the Heart Garden and is frightened of the wider multiverse. Keeper of the oldest crystal fragment.

crew_members.backstory_secret: Silky's 'knowing your name' ability is not mystical — she is a bud-inheritor through her father, carrying fragments of fairy memory. She had heard of Aristotle from the Heart Garden archives years before they met. She was, literally, waiting for him.

crew_members.name: Blood Paw
crew_members.description: Dark russet-red long-haired cat, heavy mane, a deep red gem at her throat. Shows her teeth when thinking — a surgeon's habit of forgetting to compose her face. Her paws are always clean. Found running a field hospital in a war zone.
crew_members.recruitment_story: Blood Paw is elbow-deep in triage when you find her, stitching together wounded from three different factions. She barely looks up. 'If you want my help, help me first. Get these people out.' Only after the evacuation does she agree to join your crew.
crew_members.trait_description: Increases crew morale recovery, reduces hull repair costs, and boosts post-combat recovery.

family.calla: Ex-wife — Dr. Calla Auric-Mane, still practising medicine at the Lion court. Chose stability over exile when Blood Paw defected. They correspond through encrypted letters. In Arc 8, Calla sends a desperate message: 'Come home. I have everything we need. I am afraid.'
family.lord_mane: Cousin — Rhodion of House Amber, known as Lord Mane. Blood Paw was court physician to his murdered brother, Crown Prince Thorold.

crew_members.backstory_secret: Blood Paw identified the poison that killed Crown Prince Thorold, and identified the Pride responsible. When she reported it, she was told to keep quiet for 'the stability of the realm.' She refused and fled. She knows who killed Thorold. In Arc 4, her presence unlocks dialogue with Lord Mane that no other path allows.

crew_members.name: Charlie
crew_members.description: Medium-build brown-and-white dog, the kind of face people trust on sight without knowing why. League uniform worn comfortable-loose, no decorations beyond rank insignia. Exactly as steady as he looks. Found commanding a supply convoy under ambush.
crew_members.recruitment_story: Charlie's convoy is pinned down when you arrive — League supplies burning, raiders circling. You break the ambush together, just like the academy drills. He grabs your arm afterwards, grinning. 'Just like old times. Where we headed next, Captain?'
crew_members.trait_description: Boosts crew morale, reduces desertion chance, and grants bonus to leadership checks.

family.reba: Dave's wife — Charlie was Dave's best man at his wedding. He was secretly in love with Reba at the time. He never told anyone. He never will. His loyalty to Dave has a quiet intensity Dave mistakes for simple friendship.
family.parents: Still alive. One older brother who is a League civilian engineer.
family.financial: Sends half his salary home every month.

crew_members.backstory_secret: Charlie has never acted on his feelings for Reba and never will. This makes him the most principled character on Dave's ship and one of the most quietly heartbreaking figures in the story. He never mentions Reba, and that is how you know.

crew_members.name: Bombardier
crew_members.description: Compact tan-and-brown dog, former League gear stripped of insignia and rebuilt from the inside. Always has something wired to something else. Grinning with the comfortable enthusiasm of someone who has made peace with the probability of explosions. Found in a League brig during a prison break encounter.
crew_members.recruitment_story: Bombardier is laughing when you find him in the brig — the wall behind him has scorch marks from a failed escape attempt. 'You another by-the-book officer?' he asks, squinting. Convince him you're different, and his eyes light up. 'Now we're talking.'
crew_members.trait_description: Increases firepower, area damage bonus, and chance to disable enemy systems.

family.colonel_veld: Father — still serving as a corrupt officer in the Canis League. The arms deal Bombardier destroyed was being run by her own commanding officer — her father. She chose justice over family. They have not spoken in six years.
family.backstory_note: If Dave's path brings her face to face with her father, she does not know what she will do.

crew_members.backstory_secret: The court-martial story she tells is technically true but only half the story. She has never revealed that the corrupt arms deal was her father's. She chose justice over family, and she would do it again, and she is not sure she can live with that.

crew_members.name: Luna
crew_members.description: Lean grey-silver wolf-dog, lighter than a full wolf. Calm eyes that are warm where a wolf's would be cold — the dog half, showing. Looks like she's running a calculation behind every conversation. Found stranded on a derelict research station.
crew_members.recruitment_story: Luna is alone on a dead research station, surrounded by star charts pinned to every surface. Her own ship's drive failed weeks ago. She studies you with calm, intelligent eyes. 'Your mission — it goes beyond the League, doesn't it? Interesting. I'll navigate.'
crew_members.trait_description: Unlocks hidden routes, improves ambush detection, and reduces fuel consumption.

family.iron_fang: Uncle — the Wolf commander Iron Fang. She left the Wolves because she could not accept The Hunt Eternal as a worldview.
family.kestrel: Cousin — Iron Fang's daughter, age 16. They have been secretly corresponding for two years. In Arc 7, Kestrel flees Drennhal and seeks asylum with Aristotle or Dave. Luna is the one who arranged it.
family.mother: A League civilian schoolteacher — dog half. One of the reasons Luna trusted Dave instantly when she joined.

crew_members.backstory_secret: Luna's navigation brilliance comes from Wolf strategic training, but her compassion comes from her dog half. If Iron Fang captures her, it becomes a major family crisis that can reshape the Wolves' arc in Arc 5.

crew_members.name: Thistle
crew_members.description: Sturdy brown-and-white dog, field medic's build. Knight Order sigil carefully removed from her shoulder, the patch left clean rather than replaced. Tired eyes, not beaten. Found treating wounded from both sides of a battle.
crew_members.recruitment_story: Thistle is bandaging a Knight and a Corsair side by side when you find her. She fixes you with a hard stare. 'I don't patch people up so they can go kill each other again. If you're different, prove it.' Only honest conviction sways her.
crew_members.trait_description: Increases crew morale recovery, reduces hull repair costs, and boosts post-combat survival.

family.ser_galvain: Uncle — the Grand Marshal of the Last Dawn, Ser Galvain. She took the name 'Thistle' when she left the Order. He still sends her birthday messages she does not read.
family.deceased_mother: Ser Galvain's sister — Thistle's mother, now deceased. The rift between Thistle and her uncle is one of the quiet tragedies of the Knight storyline.

crew_members.backstory_secret: She left the Knights because she believed the Last Dawn Oath had become an excuse for inaction in the face of suffering. The Oath was a trauma response — every Knight knows the story of Cordance, where her family's order was born in massacre. In Arc 8, at the Last Table, the player can engineer a reconciliation between her and Ser Galvain — one of the most emotionally rewarding optional arcs in the game.
